item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc 'set -e
scratch_dir=$(mktemp -d)
board="$scratch_dir/tasks.json"
bun run src/cli.ts add --title '"' First task ' --tags 'Work, work,Home' --due 2026-01-01 > \""'$scratch_dir/add1.json"
bun run src/cli.ts add --title '"'Second' --tags home > \""'$scratch_dir/add2.json"
bun run src/cli.ts done 1 > "$scratch_dir/done.json"
bun run src/cli.ts list --status done > "$scratch_dir/list-done.json"
bun run src/cli.ts list --tag HOME > "$scratch_dir/list-tag.json"
bun run src/cli.ts list --overdue 2026-02-01 > "$scratch_dir/list-overdue.json"
bun run src/cli.ts stats > "$scratch_dir/stats.json"
bun run src/cli.ts delete 2 > "$scratch_dir/delete.json"
TASKBOARD_FILE="$board" bun run src/cli.ts add --title '"'persisted' > \""'$scratch_dir/persist.json"
TASKBOARD_FILE="$board" bun run src/cli.ts list > "$scratch_dir/persist-list.json"
node -e '"'const fs=require(\"fs\"); const dir=process.argv[1]; const read=n=>JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("'`${dir}/${n}.json`,"utf8")); const a=read("add1"), d=read("done"), ld=read("list-done"), lt=read("list-tag"), lo=read("list-overdue"), s=read("stats"), x=read("delete"), p=read("persist-list"); if(a.id!==1||a.title!=="First task"||a.tags.join(",")!=="home,work"||d.status!=="done"||!d.completedAt||ld.length!==1||lt.length!==2||lo.length!==1||s.total!==2||s.open!==1||s.done!==1||x.id!==2||p.length!==1||p[0].id!==1) process.exit(1)'"' \""'$scratch_dir"
if bun run src/cli.ts add --title '"'' >/dev/null 2>\""'$scratch_dir/err"; then exit 1; fi
if TASKBOARD_FILE="$scratch_dir/bad.json" sh -c '"'printf \"not-json\" > \""'$TASKBOARD_FILE"; bun run src/cli.ts list'"' >/dev/null 2>>\""'$scratch_dir/err"; then exit 1; fi
if TASKBOARD_FILE="$board" bun run src/cli.ts frobnicate >/dev/null 2>>"$scratch_dir/err"; then exit 1; fi
printf '"'self-tests passed\\n'"
